visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a side-on close-up of a slim, navy blue foldable smartphone being held horizontally. The phone is exceptionally thin. The scene transition shows a young Asian man in a black t-shirt standing against a brightly colored graffiti background with images of the Statue of Liberty and various abstract shapes. He holds the phone up, gesturing with his fingers to emphasize its design. (2) Close-up shots compare the profile of the blue Z Fold7 to a silver S25 Ultra using graphic overlays. Red arrow graphics and white text overlays display measurements like 8.9mm and 4.2mm. The man is shown again in the studio setting, manipulating the phone from folded to unfolded. He uses his hands to point at the Type-C port to show it is almost as thick as the phone itself. (3) The scene shifts to the back of the phone, highlighting three vertical camera lenses with metallic rings. Graphic overlays appear, labeling them as 12MP, 200MP, and 10MP. The camera cuts between the man explaining and zoomed-in shots of the device's matte navy finish. He demonstrates the thinness one last time by holding it flat on his palm before the video concludes.
